---
title: "Get Media Upload URL"
description: "Note: The Form Submission API only works with the Wix Forms app."
icon: "upload"
mode: "wide"
---

<span className="wix-method wix-method-post">POST</span>

<Tabs>

  <Tab title="REST">

    <div className="wix-api-columns">

    <div className="wix-ref">

    <Note>

    The Form Submission API only works with the Wix Forms app. Call [GetAppInstance](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/api-reference/app-management/apps/app-instance/get-app-instance) to confirm that the app named `wix_forms` is installed on the site.

    </Note>
    <br />
    Retrieves a URL, generated by [Media Manager](https://dev.wix.com/api/rest/media/media-manager/files/generate-file-upload-url), to allow clients to upload a file to a form for submission.

    ## Permissions

    This method requires one of the following permission scopes:

    <div className="wix-scopes">

    <span className="wix-scope" title="SCOPE.DC-FORMS.MANAGE-SUBMISSIONS">Manage Submissions</span>

    </div>

    Learn more about [app permissions](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/access/authorization/about-permissions).

    Callable by: `APP`, `MEMBER`, `VISITOR`.

    ## Endpoint

    ```http
    POST https://www.wixapis.com/forms/v4/submissions/media-upload-url
    ```

    ## Body Params

    <ParamField body="formId" type="string" required>

      Form ID.

      Constraints: `format GUID`.

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="filename" type="string" required>

      Name of file to upload.

      Constraints: `maxLength 300`.

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="mimeType" type="string" required>

      [Mime type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types#) of file to upload.

      For example, `'image/png'`

      Constraints: `maxLength 100`.

    </ParamField>

    ## Response Object

    <ResponseField name="uploadUrl" type="string">

      Url to upload file.

      Constraints: `maxLength 500`.

    </ResponseField>

    ## Errors

    <Note>

      This method doesn't return any custom errors, but may return standard errors. [Learn more about standard Wix errors](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/errors).

    </Note>

    </div>

    <div className="wix-examples">

    ## Examples

    <CodeGroup>

      ```bash Request
      ~~~cURL
      curl -X POST \
        'https://www.wixapis.com/form-submission-service/v4/submissions/media-upload-url' \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -H 'Authorization: <AUTH>' \
        -d '{
          "formId": "e62e3011-55cf-4de3-a497-e097b52d86b8",
          "filename": "cats.mp4",
          "mimeType": "video/mp4"
        }'
      ~~~
      ```

      ```json Response
      ~~~json
      {
        "uploadUrl": "https://upload.wixmp.com/upload/eyJhbGciOiJfdddcCI6IkpXVCJ9..z0G6bPu_K1qdoj9EK-6Lo_ZEpd2jTihSp6LEPBVqiXw"
      }
      ~~~
      ```

    </CodeGroup>

    </div>

    </div>

  </Tab>

    <div className="wix-picker-panel">

    ```javascript Get media upload URL
    import { submissions } from '@wix/forms';

    /* 
    Sample formID value: "21bcb6c7-02b3-4ed1-b6db-7856094fac03"
    Sample filename value: "cats.mp4"
    Sample mimeType value: "video/mp4"
    */

    export async function myGetMediaUploadUrlFunction(formId, filename, mimeType) {
      try {
        const uploadUrl = await submissions.getMediaUploadUrl(formId, filename, mimeType);
        console.log('Success! Upload URL:', uploadUrl);
        return uploadUrl;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        // Handle the error
      }
    }

    /* Promise resolves to:
    {
      "uploadUrl": "https://upload.wixmp.com/upload/eyJhbGciOiJfdddcCI6IkpXVCJ9..z0G6bPu_K1qdoj9EK-6Lo_ZEpd2jTihSp6LEPBVqiXw"
    }

    */
    ```

    <div className="wix-picker-panel">

    ```javascript getMediaUploadUrl (self-hosted)
    import { createClient } from '@wix/sdk';
    import { submissions } from '@wix/forms';
    // Import the auth strategy for the relevant access type
    // Import the relevant host module if needed

    const myWixClient = createClient ({
      modules: { submissions },
      // Include the auth strategy and host as relevant
    });

    async function getMediaUploadUrl(formId,filename,mimeType) {
      const response = await myWixClient.submissions.getMediaUploadUrl(formId,filename,mimeType);
    };
    ```
